theme: the illusion of control in complex geopolitical systems
grounding_notes: Follow the epic chapter outline and the preset's filter chain.
place: Strait of Hormuz and adjacent theaters
chapter_summary: Commander Sarah Lin reaches the bridge of the USS Truxtun as the Panama Crown lists in the narrow throat of the strait, oil spreading copper-red at dawn; across the water, Captain Reza Sharifi tries to keep Iranian fast-attack craft from turning a disaster into a killing, until a speedboat ignores the Seahawk warning bursts and a young crewman photographs the Truxtun before turning away. The seed must make the strait itself a pressure-cooker: traffic separation scheme, drifting dhows, black smoke, and the moment a warning shot becomes the first frame of propaganda for both sides.
subject: A tanker explodes in the Strait of Hormuz. Commander Sarah Lin and Captain Reza Sharifi converge on the disaster as minor skirmishes begin between fast-attack craft and coalition helicopters.

included_characters.role_in_chapter: Executive Officer of the USS Truxtun

quality_parameters.accessibility: clear to adult thriller readers without military background
quality_parameters.timelessness: echo classical questions of responsibility and mercy
